zh: 三起獨立事件涉及雷擊、擋風玻璃裂損與重飛
en: Three independent events involved lightning, a cracked windshield and a go-around.

zh: 航空短訊彙整：捷藍航空2026年最繁忙A320航線全在佛州 奧蘭多—聖胡安居冠、聯邦快遞MD-11貨機在邁阿密國際機場（MIA）衝出跑道 觸發FAA地面停飛措施、Positive Aviation宣佈投資6,000萬歐元 推動ATR72水陸兩棲消防機計畫
en: Aviation briefs: JetBlue's busiest A320 flights in 2026 all touch Florida; FedEx MD-11 overruns runway at Miami International Airport (MIA), triggers FAA ground stop; Positive Aviation announces €60 million for amphibious ATR72 firefighting project

zh: 六起獨立航空事件涉及樹木接觸、跑道、引擎問題與雷擊
en: Six independent aviation incidents span tree contact, runway, engine and lightning events.

zh: 航空短訊彙整：NASA 正式接收 X-59 超音速研究機，將繼續試飛、美國擬對巴西製飛機加徵10%關稅 巴西政府強烈反彈、GE Aerospace執行長宣佈$100,000捐款 支持軍人轉職航空維修培訓
en: Aviation briefs: NASA takes ownership of X-59 and will continue supersonic flight tests; U.S. Proposes Extra 10% Tariff on Brazilian-Made Aircraft; Brazil Objects; GE Aerospace CEO announces $100,000 donation for service members' aviation training

zh: 易捷航空A321neo飛行兩分鐘後引擎失速轉降
en: easyJet A321neo diverts after an in-flight engine stall

en: Fedex MD-11 overran a runway at Miami; four other independent events.
